The selected vector is cloned and only its output value changes. Existing output paths, including dangling symlinks, and existing PID-owned redirected outputs are refused. Receipts use `create_new`. The helper preserves actual `OsString` argument bytes. Receipts serialize lossy UTF-8 strings, so runtime review must confirm actual argument vectors are UTF-8 before using receipt strings as exact identities. A receipt I/O failure can leave an unpublished owned output; it cannot produce a successful helper status. The controlled serialized lease avoids simultaneous publication and these helpers are scoped to this environment.

No Cargo, rustc, Gradle, helper, probe, app or cache operation was run by this reviewer. No product source, tests, fixtures, Git state, original raw logs or receipts were changed. Only these external review reports were written. Runtime, full app/native, CI, test parity, feature reviews, performance and IDE completion require their own evidence.
